title: House of Wisdom Library and Cultural Center / Foster + Partners
summary_en: House of Wisdom is a two-storey library and cultural centre on Sharjah International Airport Road. Visitors enter from the west into a double-height reception hub organized around a central atrium. The floating roof is supported by four service cores, freeing the interior for flexible civic use. The surrounding landscape is divided into a knowledge garden, children's playground, and additional public open space.

title: Aqua Tower / Studio Gang
summary_en: Aqua Tower is an 82-storey mixed-use skyscraper rising 250 metres in Chicago. Its undulating facade was inspired by the stratified limestone outcroppings of the Great Lakes region. The tower combines hotel, rental residential, condominium, retail, and office uses above a podium with a large landscaped terrace. The project is recognized as a landmark contribution to Chicago's lineage of high-rise innovation.

title: Capital Gate / RMJM
summary_en: Capital Gate is a mixed-use tower on the ADNEC exhibition grounds in Abu Dhabi. The building is known for its dramatic lean, recognized by Guinness World Records as the world's furthest-leaning man-made tower. A sculptural stainless steel splash form marks the base, while a free-form atrium and glass roof bring daylight deep into the interior. Offices occupy the lower floors and the upper levels house the Hyatt at Capital Centre hotel.

title: Shenzhen Energy Mansion / BIG
materials: Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Group glazing
summary_en: Shenzhen Energy Mansion is a 96,000 m² office development composed of two towers wrapped in an undulating envelope. The folded skin responds to solar orientation, maximizing north-facing glazing and minimizing solar gain from harsher exposures. Alternating transparent and opaque zones create different performance conditions and city readings across the facade. BIG described the project as an early realized example of 'engineering without engines' through architectural form.

title: The Twist Museum / BIG
materials: Aloxide by Coil exterior cladding finish
summary_en: The Twist is BIG's first built project in Norway, operating simultaneously as a museum and a pedestrian bridge across the Randselva river at Kistefos. The rectangular beam rotates 90 degrees at its midpoint, turning floor into wall and producing the building's defining twist. The geometry resolves the different elevations of the two riverbanks while creating a distinctive gallery sequence. A full-height glazed end frames views of the historic pulp mill and river landscape.
